text:
Eve (MicaFin): Hi team — request intake: we want Redwood to host a fraud-orchestration stack that does a lightweight classification (50M) and a 7B reranker. Requirements: EU data residency, customer-managed HSM (keys cannot leave), no retention of raw transaction payloads, and E2E p99 <150ms including network. Renewal in ~45 days so timeline is sensitive. Can CS advise next steps?
Rohan (CS): Hey Eve — Rohan here. Quick clarifying Qs: steady qps and peak? Do you have an eval holdout and compliance checklist? Any special appeals/ explainability needs?
Eve (MicaFin): Typical steady 25 qps, peaks to 200 qps during batch clears. We have 600k labeled past events and a curated 5k holdout. Need appeals metadata: top-3 reasons and confidence score. No PII in samples; still need EU-only processing.
Lina (Solutions): Given p99 target and peaks, Dedicated with burst capacity + region pinning is recommended. Also sounds like the reranker should run quantized via ONNX runtime. Do you require model weights to be air-gapped or okay to store in our encrypted model store if keys are customer-managed?
Eve (MicaFin): We cannot allow model weights to be exported out of our VPC. Prefer private deployment (VPC) with Redwood control plane. If that's not feasible, customer-owned KMS that wraps keys is required.
Ben (AM): Noted — renewal risk flagged. I'll propose a 60-day pilot with usage credit to buy time. If we can commit a fast-track intake and a canary within 2 weeks, that should keep them engaged.
Samir (Security): Requirements: HSM integration checklist, proof that replay logs strip transaction ids, and an audit log export for 90 days. Also need to confirm whether differential privacy is required for telemetry; customer says no PII but ask is explicit no raw retention.
onboard-bot: Intake ticket created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/1746789001. Items: intake form, security matrix, private deployment evaluation, eval harness request, canary plan.
Lina (Solutions): Proposed canary snippet: 
```
canary_pct: 8
min_calls: 2500
monitors: [e2e_latency_p99, false_positive_rate, error_rate, appeal_rate]
rollback_on: e2e_latency_p99 > 180ms OR false_positive_rate > 0.7% OR error_rate >= 1%
region_lock: EU
```
Lina (Solutions): We'll need a 2k-sample of real traffic (anonymized) + the 5k holdout to validate quality. Eve, can you drop SFTP path to the secure intake ticket?
Eve (MicaFin): Uploading now. DMing sftp creds to Rohan and Lina. Also note: legal requires KBA for key custody.
Rohan (CS): Action items: 1) Eve to confirm SFTP upload and KMS/HSM vendor. 2) Lina to size Dedicated/private footprint and cost estimate. 3) Samir to run HSM compatibility & audit retention plan. 4) Ben to draft pilot SOW to cover renewal gap. Kickoff scheduled tomorrow 11:00 CET.
Ben (AM): I'll start SOW draft and propose pilot credits. Putting account on renewal watch.
Samir (Security): I'll validate KMS vendors and request a security questionnaire from MicaFin. Will add explainability gating to the safety checklist.
Eve (MicaFin): Thanks all — appreciate the quick triage. Looking to have canary in 10 business days if possible. :pray:
